original.text: pakṣapāto na me vīre na dveṣaḥ kapilādiṣu / yuktimad vacanaṃ yasya tasya kāryaḥ parigrahaḥ
original.edition: recalled by the unit author (wording believed standard; to be checked against an edition)

paraphrase: I have no partiality for Mahāvīra, nor hatred for Kapila and the others; whoever's word is reasoned should be accepted.
notes: Wording well known; verse number recalled.
